title: LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Outpaint Video Frame Extension
summary: An Input-Conditioned LoRA for the LTX-2.3 22B model that enables video outpainting by using black pixels as mask sentinels. It generates temporally stable content to extend canvas dimensions while maintaining original scene consistency.
research_notes: Requires pure black (0,0,0) for masking; widely used in ComfyUI with GGUF/FP8 variants for low-VRAM GPUs.

evolution.summary: The base LTX-2.3 model evolved into a distilled v1.1 version with improved VAE for texture stability. Workflows now utilize a specific 'Gamma Trick' to prevent the model from misidentifying dark shadows as areas requiring outpainting.
